name: SAM quasi-global aquaplanet hypohydrostatic simulations (-4K, +0K)
access: The initial sounding, meridional surface temperature profile, and source code to re-run the simulation can be found at https://zenodo.org/record/4118346#.YaT_WtBKg-w. The output from the SAM simulations, which is several TB, is archived at MIT and is available upon request. Paper accompanying data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8140536

scales.note: Quasi-global aquaplanet CRM coarse-grained by factor of 8 to 96 km with 180-min sampling; run span covers at least 587 days; size stated as several TB.
